title: 엄마 봉투
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad with R&B influences. A clean, fingerpicked acoustic guitar plays a repetitive four-bar arpeggiated pattern. A soft, muffled kick drum enters on beats 1 and 3, accompanied by a subtle shaker on eighth notes. A warm, melodic electric bass follows the root notes of the guitar progression. Female vocals are delivered in a breathy, intimate chest voice, transitioning to a light head voice for higher melodic leaps. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the vocal melody and the acoustic guitar. Key of E Major. Tempo is 78 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerpicked acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1]
[breathy female vocals]
월급 들어왔다 알림 세 번 울려 [soft kick drum enters]
잔고를 확인해 또 한 번 확인해
은행 ATM에서 봉투를 꺼내 담아 [shaker enters]
손이 떨려 어른이 된 건 맞는 건지
한 달의 무게가 봉투 하나에 담겨
현관문 열리고 엄마 슬리퍼 소리
가슴이 뛰어 첫 번째 보고
엄마 이거 용돈이야
